title: Sousou no Frieren
episodeName: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
desc: Fifty years after their victory over the Demon King, Frieren reunites with her old companions for a rare celestial event. As time takes its toll on her human friends, Frieren realizes how little she knew about them and takes on a new apprentice, Fern, at Heiter's request.
author: Madhouse
